overall_assessment: OUTSIDE THE SAMPLE: uio_FYS5930L-2_2025_autumn_1 leaks two staff names into published course_plans.RDS and plan_sections.RDS ('Ta kontakt med [navn] eller [navn]'), because .anon_uio() only strips names followed by '(e-mail)'. The 10 sampled courses are clean: the exam-links footer is cut exactly in all 47 offerings, both name_like flags are false alarms (APA manual title, 'British Studies'), and the only defect is a stray space left where an e-mail was removed.

findings.evidence: ikke er meldt til studieadministrasjonen , før forelesningen starter.
findings.description: The functional address studieinfo@ibv.uio.no is removed, which is correct under the rubric, but the space before it stays, so the sentence reads 'studieadministrasjonen , før'. In the sample this is cosmetic. Across all 47 UiO offerings, 8 have an e-mail removed. Outside the sample the same mechanism leaves phrases that read wrongly: 'Dette gjøres via e-post til .' (PROF3025), 'meldt til Naturfagsenteret på e-post  før' (NAT5000), and 'Ta kontakt med eller studieadministrasjonen ved Institutt for geofag' (GEO5930L, MAT5930L, where .anon_uio() removes the name and .anon_generic() removes the bracketed e-mail). A similar dangling slot, with a different cause (the season+year regex, which is working as intended), appears in SPA4192: 'fikk opptak fra og med . … masterspesialiseringen eller tidligere'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_generic(), the bare-email regex '\b[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\b' removes only the address token. The whitespace before it is kept, and nothing marks the gap, so a contact phrase is left without its object.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_generic(), let the bare-email removal absorb the preceding horizontal space: str_remove_all("[ \\t]*\\b[\\w.+-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\\b"), which gives 'studieadministrasjonen, før' and 'til.'. If the gaps should stay readable, replace the address with a fixed placeholder such as '[e-post]' instead of deleting it. That would be a methods.qmd decision. Add a test in tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R: 'meldt til adm x@uio.no, før' -> 'meldt til adm, før'.
